concern_summary: This concern encompasses functionalities related to the validation, formatting, and management of decimal digits in monetary contexts, ensuring accurate input and display for financial transactions.
This concern deals with the validation of money request types, ensuring that only predefined and recognized types are processed in the system.
This concern addresses the handling of user inputs for money request amounts, including validation and formatting to ensure compliance with specified criteria.

This concern encompasses functionalities related to the handling, validation, and formatting of decimal numbers, particularly in financial contexts. It addresses user input for decimal amounts, manages the representation and precision of decimal points according to currency specifications, and ensures correct formatting and calculations involving decimal places.
This concern focuses on the creation, confirmation, and management of money requests, including handling associated transactions, approvals, and the cleanup of related reports.
This concern involves functionalities related to calculating ordinal suffixes and ensuring numerical values are formatted as two-digit numbers, contributing to correct numeric representation.
This concern manages the conditional display and handling of money request reports, influencing notification preferences and user interface settings based on the report's type.
This concern is focused on the representation and conversion of standard digits to locale-specific formats, facilitating proper localization in numerical displays.
This concern pertains to determining default avatar representations based on extracted digits from identifiers, ensuring a visual identity is properly assigned.
